proposals.action_title: Publish First Premium Coloring Book on Amazon KDP (FR Market)
proposals.why_this_works_now: The coloring book pipeline (produce_coloring_book) is ready. Publishing in French ('Livre de coloriage pour adultes') lowers SEO competition compared to the saturated US market. High quality covers generated via Together AI (FLUX-schnell) will drive clicks.
proposals.first_action_today: Select the best 25 coloring pages generated by the pipeline, compile them into an 8.5x11 PDF using a Termux CLI tool like pdftk or python-reportlab, and create a free KDP account.

proposals.action_title: Upload 50 Graphic/SVG Designs as Redbubble Stickers
proposals.why_this_works_now: Stickers have the lowest barrier to purchase on Redbubble. By converting existing SVG outputs from 'produce_svg_pack' or 'produce_literal_idioms' into transparent PNGs, Hugo can capture organic search traffic with zero ad spend.
proposals.first_action_today: Use a bash script in Termux with rsvg-convert or ImageMagick to batch-convert 50 SVGs into 300dpi transparent PNGs.

proposals.action_title: Launch itch.io Page with 3 GameDev Asset Packs
proposals.why_this_works_now: The 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' pipeline can output retro/pixel UI assets, textures, or icons. Indie developers on itch.io actively buy asset packs priced between $2 and $5. Setting up a seller account is free and instantaneous.
proposals.first_action_today: Zip the output of the gamedev pipeline, write a short markdown description highlighting the engine-agnostic nature of the assets, and upload them to itch.io under a 'pay-what-you-want' model with a suggested price of $2.99.

proposals.action_title: Upload 5 Functional STL Files to Cults3D (Paid Models)
proposals.why_this_works_now: Functional, parametric 3D prints (like customized organizers, brackets, or replacement parts generated via OpenSCAD/produce_stl_parametric) sell consistently on Cults3D to 3D printing enthusiasts who value utility over aesthetics.
proposals.first_action_today: Render 3D preview images of the parametric models using OpenSCAD CLI in Termux, write a brief guide on print settings, and upload the STLs to Cults3D priced at 1.99€ each.

proposals.action_title: Open Etsy Shop with 40 Free Listings for Digital Craft SVGs
proposals.why_this_works_now: Digital downloads on Etsy have high conversion rates and 95%+ margins. By using an invite/referral link, Hugo gets 40 free listings, bypassing the 0.20$ listing fee. SVG bundles for Cricut/Silhouette crafters sell rapidly.
proposals.first_action_today: Find an Etsy referral link online to get 40 free listings, register the shop, and upload the first bundle of 10 SVG files from the 'produce_svg_pack' pipeline.
